actions.action: Shake branch over white paper to check for flying whiteflies
Inspect specks with macro lens or hand lens
Check for thrips (silvery streaks, slender insects)
Tap leaf over white paper to check for spider mites
Spray leaves with strong stream of lukewarm water every few days
Test insecticidal soap or neem oil on one leaf
Treat with insecticidal soap or neem oil every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Place yellow sticky traps and replace when full
Monitor new growth for a month

reason: The answer diagnoses whiteflies rather than aphids, but its main treatment, thorough repeated neem oil or insecticidal soap, matches the fix that worked, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
